gloss: the following year; the next year

definitions.gloss: the following year; the year after a particular reference year
definitions.explanation: A written, somewhat formal way of saying "the year after" a previously mentioned year or event. Commonly appears in news articles, biographies, timelines, and historical or academic writing. Unlike {来年|らいねん} (next year from now), {翌年|よくねん} is relative to a reference point established in context — usually the year just mentioned.

examples.japanese: {翌年|よくねん}⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They got married the following year.

examples.japanese: {翌年|よくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved to Tokyo in the spring of the following year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧し、{翌年|よくねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He graduated from university and, the following year, took a job at a large company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{1995年|せんきゅうひゃくきゅうじゅうごねん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{翌年|よくねん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The earthquake occurred in 1995, and full-scale reconstruction work began the following year.

notes:
A relative time noun meaning "the year after (a previously mentioned year)." The reference year must be established in context — {翌年|よくねん} does not mean "next year from now."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翌年|よくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧: the spring of the following year
- {翌年|よくねん}{3月|さんがつ}: March of the following year
- {翌年|よくねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the following year
- {翌年|よくねん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: starting the following year
- {翌年|よくねん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by the following year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧: next year — relative to the current year from the speaker's standpoint.
- {翌年|よくねん}: the following year — relative to a year previously mentioned in context.
- {明年|みょうねん}: next year — a more formal, written equivalent of ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧, used in letters and announcements.
- ⟦{翌|よく}→翌〜：03970_yoku⟧⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧: the following fiscal year — used when talking about fiscal or academic years rather than calendar years.

REGISTER:
Written or semi-formal. Common in news, biographies, historical writing, official reports, and narrative descriptions of sequences of events. In casual conversation, Japanese speakers often use ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧ (the next year) instead.

RELATED TIME NOUNS:
- ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧: the following day
- ⟦{翌週|よくしゅう}→翌週：25325_yokushuu⟧: the following week
- ⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧: the following month
- ⟦{翌朝|よくあさ}→翌朝：03182_yokuasa⟧: the following morning

These all follow the same pattern: ⟦{翌|よく}→翌〜：03970_yoku⟧ + time unit = "the following X." They all require a reference point from context.
